CA Bundle Tracker

Which software ships its own Certificate Authority (CA) trust store, and which uses the operating system (OS) store? A reference for how fixes propagate after a CA compromise.

$incident_name

$incident_summary

  • $keys compromised private keys: $tls_keys for TLS (Transport Layer Security) server certificates, $cs_keys for code signing.
  • $certs CA certificates carry those keys: each key has one certificate issued by an emSign root and one cross-signed by Sectigo AAA Certificate Services.

Software that bundles its own CA certificates needs its own update: an OS patch does not reach it. Java runtimes, Python environments, Node.js, container images, firmware and Electron apps each carry independent copies that can stay exposed after the OS is fixed.

Scan your system

The ca-bundle-scanner command-line tool looks for the 16 compromised eMudhra CA certificates (also by public key), the distrusted emSign ECC Root CA - G3 and its issuing CAs, and the Sectigo AAA cross-sign root in trust stores, bundles, binaries and archives on your machine.

cargo install --path scanner
ca-bundle-scanner --profile emudhra

Run ca-bundle-scanner --help for options and exit codes.
